subject: POC qualification & ramp plan — next steps
messages:
From: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwoodinference.com>
To: Clara Nguyen <clara.nguyen@novafin.com>, Sanjay Verma <sanjay@cleardata.ai>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2027-04-21T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Recap: POC discovery — next steps & info request

Hi Clara / Sanjay —

Thanks again for the demo this morning. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we have alignment before we lock dates for the POC: 

Summary of what we heard from NovaFin:
- Primary goal: reduce document-processing latency and cost for month-end reconciliation workflows (target 50% token-cost reduction vs current gen pipeline).
- Success metric: end-to-end response time <= 350ms p50 for batched reconciliation requests and maintain >= 98% label accuracy on entity extraction.
- Scope: start with two templates (invoices + statements), ~5k monthly documents in initial POC window.

Proposed POC plan (high level):
1) Kickoff & environment prep (week 0): exchange credentials, S3 access pattern, sample data slices.
2) Integration & baseline (week 1): run current model against sample set to capture baseline latency/cost/accuracy.
3) Redwood run & tuning (weeks 2–3): deploy a tuned Redwood config, run parallel baseline vs Redwood, capture metrics.
4) Wrap & decision (week 4): present results, agree next steps (dedicated / production rollout).

Immediate asks from our side (please confirm by EOD Thu):
- Provide S3 read-only path and one sanitized sample batch (10–20 documents) for integration.
- Confirm internal owner for access questions (IAM contact).
- Share any compliance constraints (data residency, retention).

I've attached a short runbook that outlines the environment details and the success-criteria spreadsheet (see attachments). If the high-level plan looks good, propose we schedule a 30-minute kickoff next Monday (Apr 26) at 10:00 PT — does that work for you?

Thanks,
Evelyn Hart
Sr. Sales Engineer | Redwood Inference
Evelyn.Hart@redwoodinference.com
+1 (415) 555-0182

Attachments: redwood-poc-runbook.pdf, poc-success-criteria.xlsx
From: Clara Nguyen <clara.nguyen@novafin.com>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Sanjay Verma <sanjay@cleardata.ai>
Date: 2027-04-21T11:04:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Recap: POC discovery — next steps & info request

Evelyn —

Appreciate the clear summary. Confirming the plan looks correct from our side. A few clarifications and notes: 

Clarifications:
- The 5k documents is an estimate for the trial window; for the test batches we'll send a stratified sample (high/low complexity).
- IAM owner: Clara Nguyen (me) — I'll send a short-lived service account and the S3 path by EOD Thursday.
- Compliance: data can remain in our us-west-2 bucket; retention requirement is 90 days for any logs. No additional legal review required for this POC.

Success criteria addition:
- Add a business KPI: reduce manual review exceptions by 30% for the sampled templates.

Kickoff: Apr 26 at 10:00 PT works for me. I'll add a calendar invite with Clara/Sanjay and your team.

Thanks — looking forward to the kickoff.

— Clara
Clara Nguyen
Head of Data Services | NovaFin
clara.nguyen@novafin.com

Subject: Re: Recap: POC discovery — next steps & info request

Thanks Clara — great, that's helpful. I've updated the success-criteria sheet with the manual-review KPI and added a row for retention. Please review the Drive link I shared (copied below) if you want to annotate the runbook directly.

Mutual action plan (attached runbook has the step owners):
- Redwood: provide runbook, model config suggestion, and one-week support window for tuning (owner: Evelyn).
- NovaFin: provide sample batches, service account for S3, and a point of contact for validation (owner: Clara).
- Ops/CS checkpoint: weekly sync (30m) during the POC; first sync scheduled for Apr 29.

Action items before kickoff (owners):
- Clara: share S3 access and sample batch (due: 2027-04-22 17:00 PT).
- Monica: prepare baseline script + metric collection (due: 2027-04-23 EOD).
- Aditya: ensure Redwood test environment is provisioned and preloaded with suggested quantization profile (due: 2027-04-24 12:00 PT).

I'll attach the runbook and the updated criteria in the calendar invite. If anything slips, call out blockers in the shared doc and we'll escalate.

Drive: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3c
HubSpot: https://hubspot.company/deal/DEAL-8291

Regards,
Evelyn

Subject: Re: POC preparation — baseline script & checklist

Evelyn — quick update from my side: 

- Baseline script is built and running against the sanitized sample location (local results show current pipeline p50 ~ 620ms for the two templates). I'll push the metric-output CSV to the shared Drive by EOD.
- I'm logging two small risks: (1) sample set contains a non-trivial fraction of encrypted PDFs that need preprocessing (we'll note this in the runbook), (2) retention policy will require us to purge logs after 90 days — I'll add a purge step in the script.

Aditya — can you confirm the test environment provisioning timeline? If you hit any infra delay, flag it here so we can adjust the kickoff.

Thanks,
Monica

- S3 access: received (thanks) 
- Sample batch: received and sanitized 
- Baseline script: Monica has pushed initial CSV; baseline p50 ~ 620ms (we'll confirm exact numbers at kickoff)
- Redwood env: Aditya reports provisioned and quantization profile applied.

Two asks before kickoff: 
1) Please confirm your stakeholder for final review (legal/ops) who will attend the wrap session on May 24 (tentative) — name/email.
2) If you have any restricted fields we should mask beyond what's in the runbook, reply here.

If we don't hear by 9:30 PT tomorrow we'll proceed with the kickoff and loop in an alternate NovaFin reviewer via calendar. Looking forward to the session — we'll use the Drive doc for live notes.

Best,
